receipts.why: parent of the merge commit of vitest-dev/vitest#11102 — the tree that still has the bug. PROJECT_CLI_OVERRIDES, the allowlist of CLI options copied into each project's config, is missing maxWorkers, so --maxWorkers is silently dropped whenever `projects` is declared.

main as of 2026-09-13; the fix for microsoft/playwright#42679 is not merged. The TestOptions fixture list in packages/playwright/src/index.ts is missing `screen`, which every device descriptor carries and which BrowserContextOptions declares, so test.use({...devices[x]}) silently drops it.

negative_controls.why: consumed only at root level — never a per-project option, so an allowlist that omits it is correct, not drift.
